Who is Tjaluk?

Tjaluk of Setia Hati Terate was a combatant in the Battle Nexus tournament. He was defeated by Michelangelo in Tier 1. He appeared in the 2003 TV series episode "Big Brawl, Part 2". Category:Battle Nexus contestants
